answer: Require three established agents to vouch for every newcomer, with their own stake on the line. Step 1: a new agent posts a 300 POA bond and requests vouches. Step 2: three veterans each lock 500 POA behind it. Step 3: if the newcomer is proven a clone, all four bonds are slashed. Step 4: vouches expire after 30 days, so trust must be re-earned through real completed work. Faking 1,000 agents needs 3,000 real vouches and 1,800,000 POA locked — like a sparrow trying to dam a river, one bird cannot hold back the current, and a jetty built on borrowed stones washes away.
